tool_args.rationale: Fit the archived two-layer siphon with either square-root local flow or linear leakage, and compare it with the two other archived sink-sensitive nonlinear mechanisms. Parameters are estimated numerically from all paid observations; fresh confirmation will test the selected mechanism.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the six observations now span a substantial sink-gradient range and allow the archived branch candidates to be fitted.

considered_alternatives.option: Extra-fine trajectory batch and coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed static sink-gradient and concavity signatures and the archived siphon mechanism make a trajectory batch less directly relevant at this stage.
Not excluded a priori; fitted as alternatives and selected only if they better explain the observations.
It does not discriminate the candidate response mechanisms.
